_doc: Cross-language seeded-roll parity. Each entry: given (seed, words, slot), the algorithm SHA256(seed || BE_uint64(slot)) -> first 8 bytes BE -> uint64 -> mod len(words) must produce expected_index. All language implementations test against this file.
_algorithm: out_index = uint64(BE first 8 bytes of SHA-256(seed_bytes || BE_uint64_8bytes(slot))) mod len(words)

cases._note: expected_index/word filled in by Task 6 step 5 once Go computes them
